## 0050e48a0620

**No issue found** for generator SHA-256
`5dd808c0d669f7a71b0ad47165688c429e1a7e45bee8671d8967a48383a969ef`.
I read the generator and checked the main shortcut surfaces: exact override
observability, canonical-profile acceptance, color-as-label shortcuts,
rectangle-vs-near-rectangle discrimination, and lesson identifiability.

- Lint passed: `checks/audit/0050e48a0620/lint/`.
- The override gate accepted all 3,240/3,240 draws across 36 cases and three
  bands with no findings: `checks/audit/0050e48a0620/override/`.
- The semantic gate accepted 4/4 canonical inputs, observed all 5 declared
  witnesses in 600/600 samples, verified all 5 rival claims, and found all
  12/12 sampled two-demonstration lessons identifiable; all 36 diagnostic
  query rotations were also distinguished:
  `checks/audit/0050e48a0620/semantic/`.

The design deliberately places a filled rectangle and a non-rectangle in the
same input color in non-anchor scenes, so a global input-color label rule is
refuted inside each such scene. Every ordinary scene also includes a
one-corner-missing near rectangle, which refutes an “almost rectangular counts”
shortcut. This is finite evidence against the declared rivals, not a proof
against every possible induction rule; I left the audited source unchanged.
